tasks.title: Add the Geometry to the Work: type, identity, geometryEquals, workSize, rotateQuarter and flipOnScreen
tasks.dod: Vitest proves identityGeometry, geometryEquals field by field (incl. H+V Flip on 180° ≠ equal), workSize, rotateQuarter (frame turns with the image, 4 turns / one each way give back an equal Geometry) and flipOnScreen (screen axis at 90°/270°, Crop mirrored, straighten sign flipped, two flips equal), and createWork sets the identity Geometry

tasks.title: Keep the Crop inside the turned image: clampCrop, whole-pixel rounding, move and resize by edge or corner
tasks.dod: Vitest property tests prove moveCrop and resizeCrop (any edge or corner, any delta) always return a Crop in whole pixels, fully inside the turned image, at least 1×1 and never inside out, with odd centring pixels going right/bottom (AC-02)

tasks.title: Add the Straighten angle rules: setStraighten around the frame's centre and fitCropInside with no empty corner
tasks.dod: Vitest property tests prove setStraighten clamps to −450…450 tenths and keeps the frame's centre on the same image content, and fitCropInside returns the largest same-proportion integer Crop inside the turned image around that centre (moved only when the centre is outside), never growing back towards 0° (AC-05, AC-06)

tasks.title: Add proportions, typed crop sizes and the field input rules (parseAngle, parseCropSize, plain decimal only)
tasks.dod: Vitest proves applyProportion (largest centred frame, long side input, half-up short side, 0.5 px tolerance, Original follows Rotation, orientation turns), setCropSize (typed side is input, resize around centre, minimal move) and parseAngle/parseCropSize (snap, round, revert, 1e2 not a number, decimal comma) against AC-07 to AC-10

tasks.title: Derive the one transform: cropToOriginalUv, turnedImageToOriginalUv, turnedBounds and the overlay's screen maths
tasks.dod: Vitest proves cropToOriginalUv maps every Crop pixel centre (p + 0.5) to the right Original texel centre for all 16 Rotation × Flip combinations (with and without a Crop) and inside the Crop's source area under a Straighten angle, turnedBounds/turnedImageToOriginalUv cover the whole turned image, and the overlay maths round-trips screen ↔ image pixels through the View

tasks.title: Render the Geometry in the shared shader (u_geometry) and give the Preview renderer setGeometry(g, 'crop' | 'whole')
tasks.dod: Vitest on the fake GL proves the vertex shader declares u_geometry, the fragment shader returns transparent outside the Original, setGeometry(g, 'crop'|'whole') uploads cropToOriginalUv or turnedImageToOriginalUv with the quad sized by the shown size, magnification is LINEAR iff straighten ≠ 0, and the identity Geometry draws exactly as before

tasks.title: Export with the Geometry in the worker and add the GPU alpha check (checkCropTransparency)
tasks.dod: Vitest (fake GL) proves the worker computes u_geometry with cropToOriginalUv at an export size counted from workSize, applies the LINEAR-when-straightened rule, and answers { kind: 'alpha' } with Result<boolean> from a full-size alpha readback, closing the bitmap copy in every branch, through both the worker and the in-window fallback

tasks.title: Add the editor store's tool slot: activeTool, openTool/closeTool, previewGeometry, applyGeometry, activePanel and tool-aware fit-View
tasks.dod: Vitest on a real editor store proves openTool refuses with a reason with no Work, while exporting or with a tool open; applyGeometry raises the revision only when geometryEquals is false; beginExport refuses while a tool is open; a successful replace (confirmed or not) closes the tool while a failed read or a declined replace keeps it; and fit-View measures turnedBounds while a tool is open and workSize otherwise

tasks.title: Make the Preview and the status bar follow the Geometry, and add the setGeometry test hook
tasks.dod: Component tests prove the status bar shows workSize followed by ", from W × H px" exactly when width or height differs in order (incl. a 90° Rotation alone) and still shows the applied Work while a tool is open, PreviewCanvas calls setGeometry(work.geometry, 'crop') with no tool and setGeometry(previewGeometry, 'whole') with one, no component reads original.width/height as the Work's size, and window.__imglyTest.setGeometry applies a Geometry through applyGeometry

tasks.title: Size the export from workSize, send the Geometry, and base the transparency hint on the GPU check
tasks.dod: Store tests prove full size, presets and the long side count from workSize; a remembered long side larger than the Work snaps for display and comes back when the Crop widens; the export request carries the Geometry; and transparencyHint uses original.hasTransparency when false or identity, else the alpha check cached by (work id, revision), hidden while running and shown on failure

tasks.title: Refuse Export and Ctrl/Cmd+S while a tool is open with the 'apply or cancel the crop first' hint, and report the open panel
tasks.dod: Tests prove that while editor.activeTool is set the Export action is unavailable with the hint, the save shortcut calls preventDefault and raises "Apply or cancel the crop first, then export." instead of opening the panel, and that opening and closing the panel sets editor.activePanel to 'export' and null

tasks.title: Extend SliderField (step, decimals, marks), NumberField (signed decimal input) and BaseButton (pressed), and register them
tasks.dod: primitives.test.ts proves SliderField with step 0.1, decimals 1 and a mark at 0 emits one-decimal values and arrow-key steps (Shift ×10), NumberField with a decimal option accepts sign, point and comma text and commits only on blur or Enter, BaseButton pressed sets aria-pressed, existing uses are unchanged, and docs/design-system.md rows for the three primitives describe the new options

tasks.title: Add the crop-rotate store: Draft, Geometry at open, remembered proportion per Work, field state, apply / cancel / reset
tasks.dod: Vitest with a real editor store proves open copies work.geometry as Draft and Geometry-at-open and pushes it to previewGeometry; each action (rotate, flip, straighten, move/resize, proportion, typed size/angle) goes through core and updates previewGeometry; apply calls applyGeometry then closeTool; cancel only closes; reset changes only the Draft and sets Free; the proportion is remembered per Work id at once (even after cancel) until the Work is replaced; and the Draft is dropped when the editor closes the tool on a replace

tasks.title: Add the 'Crop and rotate' toolbar action, its hints, the C shortcut and the tool's message catalog
tasks.dod: Component and unit tests prove the action is visible next to Export, reachable by Tab and activated by Enter/Space; with no Work it is aria-disabled and raises "Open an image first to crop or rotate it." (also on C); during an export it is disabled and C does nothing; C does nothing while the export panel is open, the tool is open or a text field has focus; pressed while the tool is open; and App.vue mounts it before ExportAction

tasks.title: Build CropOverlay: dimmed outside, frame with 8 focusable handles, both grids, pointer drags and arrow keys
tasks.dod: Component tests on happy-dom prove the overlay places four dimming panels, the frame and 8 labelled focusable handles from the overlay maths, a pointer drag on an edge/corner resizes and inside the frame moves via the store (stopping at the image edge), arrow keys move the focused frame or resize the focused handle by 1 px (10 with Shift), the thirds grid shows only while dragging and the fine grid only while the angle changes, and positions are written with transform only

tasks.title: Build CropRotateControls: rotate and flip buttons, straighten slider and field, proportion, width and height, Reset / Cancel / Apply
tasks.dod: Component tests prove the panel renders the five groups in order with the catalog labels, rotate/flip buttons call the store, the slider (−45…45, step 0.1, 0 mark) and angle field show one signed decimal, the proportion controls select and disable orientation for Free and 1:1, width/height show the Draft's size live and commit only on blur or Enter (Enter not applying the tool), and Reset/Cancel/Apply call the store

tasks.title: Mount CropRotateTool in a new EditorView tool slot, with Enter to apply, Escape to cancel, focus handling and fit-View
tasks.dod: Component tests prove EditorView renders the tool slot over the canvas area only while editor.activeTool is set, CropRotateTool lays out CropOverlay over the canvas and the panel at --panel-width (under the canvas below 1024 px), Enter applies outside a field and a focused button, Escape cancels from anywhere including a field (discarding pending text), focus moves to the frame on open and back to the action on close, and zoom and pan keep working without changing the Draft

tasks.title: Add the e2e Geometry fidelity suite: 16 Rotation × Flip, straightened vs Preview, opacity, nothing outside the Crop, lossless round trip
tasks.dod: Playwright on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit proves all 16 Rotation × Flip combinations (with and without a Crop) export within 2/255 of the Original pixel named by an independent inverse mapping, straightened Exports at −45°, −0.1°, +1°, +45° match the Preview at 100% within 2/255 and stay 100% opaque for an opaque Original, a band outside the Crop never appears and the Export is exactly the Crop's size, and Crop → Reset → Apply gives an Export within 2/255 of the one before

tasks.title: Add the e2e tool-flow suite: three-action paths, export refusals, replace while open, View fit and frame alignment
tasks.dod: Playwright on Chromium, Firefox and WebKit proves rotate-once and crop-to-square each take three actions by mouse and by keyboard, Apply shows the Crop's size "from" the Original's, Ctrl/Cmd+S and Export while the tool is open show the hint without "Save page", a drop while open keeps the tool until the replace is confirmed and keeps it when declined, the View fits the whole turned image on open and the Work after Apply/Cancel, and the frame sits on the image edge within one device pixel at 100% and 800%

tasks.title: Add the @perf suite: drag and slider frame interval, action-to-Preview and tool-ready times, memory after 50 Applies, export time with a Geometry
tasks.dod: PERF=1 pnpm test:e2e runs e2e/crop-rotate/perf.spec.ts (Chromium) reporting p95 over 20 runs after 2 warm-ups for the drag/slider frame interval (≤33 ms), rotate/flip/Apply/Cancel/Reset to updated Preview (≤150 ms), choosing the tool to tool-ready (≤150 ms) and memory after 50 Applies (≤110% of first), and export's perf spec repeats JPEG/PNG with a 90° Rotation, a Flip and a 10° angle; without PERF=1 they are skipped
